title: INDIAN NAVAL SHIP TRISHUL CONCLUDES PORT CALL AT SAFAGA, EGYPT
body_text: Indian Naval Ship (INS) Trishul concluded her port call at Safaga Naval Base, Egypt, on 09 Nov 2026, as part of her ongoing operational deployment. The port call further reinforced the growing India–Egypt defence and maritime partnership , in the backdrop of the 11th India–Egypt Joint Defence Committee (JDC) meeting held in Cairo in Apr 2026 ( https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=2254773 ). The 11th JDC meeting provided an institutional framework for advancing defence commitments under the Memorandum of Understanding (MoU) on Defence Cooperation signed in Sep 2022, following the elevation of bilateral ties to a Strategic Partnership in 2023. During the visit, the Commanding Officer of INS Trishul called on RAdm MD Abd El Maksoud, Commander, Red Sea Naval Base, Egypt. Discussions covered maritime security in the Gulf of Suez and the strategic significance of the Red Sea. The ship's crew also visited Egyptian Naval Ship ENS Port Said (976), gaining insights into its operational capabilities and the best practices followed by the Egyptian Navy. The visit further featured reciprocal interactions between personnel of the Indian and Egyptian navies, along with joint diving training activities. These professional engagements provided opportunities for exchange of operational experience, sharing of Best Practices and furthering mutual understanding between the two navies. The port call reaffirmed the longstanding defence ties between India and Egypt and their shared commitment to maritime security and regional stability. Following completion of the engagements, INS Trishul proceeded for the next phase of her operational deployment. *** VM/AS                                                                                                         240/26
